messages:
Sara: FYI — customer reported no welcome credits after signup + email verify. Account: user_jane@example.com, acct_id=acct_004821. She signed up via Google SSO, EU IP, card BIN shows US. 3DS completed.
Sara: Ticket #12458 from Intercom attached. Customer says they verified email and saw 'verification successful' but balance still 0.
Sara: Repro notes: signup -> email verify -> payment method add (VISA ends 4242) -> 3DS flow -> success. No credits.
Sara: Logs show grant job attempted but returned gated_reason: region_payment_conflict. Snippet:```json
{
  "acct_id": "acct_004821",
  "event": "signup_credit_attempt",
  "result": "blocked",
  "gate": "region_mismatch/payment_method_country"
}
```
Michael: @sara thanks — can you paste the full payment source payload and the IP country? I want to see which gate fired first. Also send the customer email + acct id again.
Sara: IP geo: DE. Billing country (card): US. payment_source.id = ps_9a8b7c. Attached the Intercom thread.
Michael: Looks like the auto-grant pipeline flagged cross-border BIN vs IP. We have a manual override flow for obvious false-positives. I'll run diagnostics.
Eli: tagging in eng because we've been chasing a race where the grant job sometimes runs before the payment verification webhook finishes. If webhook arrives after grant job, we end up in a stale-state check and gate out. Could be same here since 3DS was slow (~12s).
Sara: Customer reported 3DS spinner for ~10s then completed.
Michael: I queried grants table: ```sql
SELECT * FROM welcome_grants WHERE acct_id='acct_004821' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Michael: Result: most recent row has status=blocked, reason='region_payment_conflict', created_at=2026-03-11T14:22:03Z. No successful grant row.
Michael: Manual fix steps: (1) confirm no previous successful grant (2) run admin command:```bash
redwood-admin grant-credits --acct acct_004821 --amount 50 --reason "manual: support override after false-positive gate"
```
Michael: I'll hold off until support posts OK to proceed. Noted risk: if the delayed webhook later triggers an auto-grant, we could double-grant. After manual grant, mark welcome_grants.override=true to prevent duplicate.
Sara: Please proceed, customer anxious. I'll notify them when done. :pray:
Michael: Doing manual grant now. Running command...
deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-payments v2.18.3 promoted to prod (sha: a1b2c3). CI link: https://ci.redwood.ai/1234 :information_source:
Michael: Command returned: success. Grant id=wg_778899, amount=50, actor=michael.payments. I also set welcome_grants.override=true for acct_004821.
Sara: Customer notified, they confirmed balance now shows 50 credits. :tada:
Eli: I'll open a follow-up issue for the race condition: payments webhook ordering vs grant job. Proposal: add an idempotent check that waits up to 15s for pending payment verification events before gating.
Michael: Filed ENG-1567 with repro steps and log traces. Punted to eng oncall.
Eli: Oncall will look. For now manual override flow documented at https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/support/manual-grant (cc @michael).
Sara: Closing ticket after customer confirms usage. Adding note: manual-grant used due to region/payment race; recommended to run backfill to find similar failures in last 24h.
Michael: Running backfill query to find accounts with gate=region_payment_conflict in last 24h. Will post results in this thread shortly.
Michael: Backfill found 7 hits in last 24h. I created payment-escalation list and alerted SRE for possible cascade.
Sara: Thanks team. Leaving this thread in case eng wants more logs.
